values.note: Campsites $24-37 a night May-September; October-April self-registration $20 non-electric, $26 electric. Park use free. $10 to change a reservation; no refunds. Stays of 7+ nights pay for 6 on most sites.

fees.source: https://www.clarkcountywi.gov/for-parks-russell-memorial ('Campsites range from $24 to $37 per night'); /off-season-camping ('Fees range from $26/night/unit for an electric site and $20/night/unit for non electric'); /campground-policies-rules ('Refunds are not offered. values.note: Full services May 1 - September 30. October-April is self-registration with reduced services and access not guaranteed; the heated shower building at the entrance may stay open through the gun deer season.

season.source: https://www.clarkcountywi.gov/for-parks-russell-memorial ('Self-registration camping is available throughout the remainder of the year but please note that campground facilities are extremely limited during this time and we cannot guarantee access during these months'); /off-season-camping ('October 1st - April 30th ... all campsites are walk-in (first-come-first-serve) & self-registration only'; 'Russell Memorial (entrance building)')

values.note: Reservations open January 1 for the same calendar year, must be made at least 3 days ahead and cover 2+ nights. Sites not reserved 3 days out are first come, first served, as is every site October-April. Most sites cap a stay at 28 nights; some lakeside sites at 14.

booking.source: https://www.clarkcountywi.gov/campground-policies-rules ('Reservations can only be made within the same calendar year and must be made at least three (3) days in advance of check-in date, and reserve for a minimum of two (2) nights. Within three (3) days all unreserved campsites are first come first serve'; 'Reservations for 2026 will begin on January 1st at 8am'); Extended Stay Camping Policy 4.1-4.3

note: On the Arnold Creek arm of Lake Arbutus, near the Levis Mound mountain-bike and hiking trails. Sites 31-39 are closed for construction from October 5, 2026. Designated ATV/UTV sites connect to the county trail system; ATVs may not use the park's blacktop. Generators are generally not permitted. Shoreline docking is first come, first served and open to the public. Business office 715-743-5140. --Claude
summary: County property page, map PDF, policies and off-season page read (WebTrac refuses, not tried). About 200 sites; $24-37 May-Sept, self-registration Oct-Apr $20-26. Lakefront KEPT: the map's blue 'Lake Side' sites line the Arnold Creek arm of Lake Arbutus with rigs 15-25 m from the water over open grass, and they are sold by the night. Designated ATV sites: OHV-side flag. Pin sits at the entrance/day-use lot ~435 m south of the camping loops: move. Phone: campground line 715-333-7948. Google 4.5 (604).
flags: Lakefront KEPT (no --AWH value): the map's blue 'Lake Side & non-ATV Campsites' - 31-45, 47, 48, 50-56, 59-61, 63-66, 71, 73-77, 79, 80, 82, 84, 85, 88-96 - line the Arnold Creek arm of Lake Arbutus (an 80-110 m-wide arm of the 821-acre flowage). Esri imagery shows rigs 15-25 m from the shore over open grass with a dock at many sites, e.g. sites ~50-56 near 44.4255,-90.7221 and sites ~85-96 near 44.4297,-90.7240. All reservable by the night (the lakeside sites carry 14- or 28-night caps). Sites 31-39 are closed for construction from 2026-10-05.
PIN MOVE ~435 m: stored 44.4223,-90.7236 is at the south entrance/day-use parking by the beach; the campground loops span 44.4235-44.4302. Target 44.4262,-90.7242 (middle of the main loops).

PHONE 715-743-5140 -> 715-333-7948: the campground's own line ('715-333-7948 (May 1st - Sept 31st)', also Google's). 715-743-5140 is the year-round Forestry and Parks business office (kept in the note).

OHV side (flag, not a drop): 'There are designated ATV/UTV campsites that connect to the county wide trail system. ATV/UTV operation on any blacktop in Russell Memorial is prohibited.' The map marks the ATV sites in red (99-168 west row, the O overflow sites). A large general lake campground with an ATV section, not a trail-system base.

Season changed: stored 'approximate May-November' -> year_round true with reduced Oct-Apr services (county: self-registration 'throughout the remainder of the year', access not guaranteed). Reservation window May 1 - Sept 30 is now booking.season.
sites.max_rig_ft 25 (derived from old note prose) is not supported by any page read; per-site sizes are only in WebTrac (not fetched). Left as stored; the reviewer may want to clear it.

Long stays: many sites have no seasonal cap under the Extended Stay policy, but every site is reserved by the night (7+ nights is only a discount). Not a long-stay park.
